concrete_scene.heading: Worked scaling forecast: two models enter, the holdout stays closed
concrete_scene.actor_or_system: A scaling study, two preregistered candidate families, three attempts, a frozen metric and compute regime, and a held-out scale
concrete_scene.attempted_action: Use observed scales to make a prospective prediction at a held-out scale while preserving alternatives and failed attempts.
concrete_scene.observable_outcome: Both candidate models are scored, attempts 11–13 stay in the denominator, and changes to metric, architecture, population, or regime invalidate the receipt.
concrete_scene.failed_or_tested_boundary: The scene tests whether a winning retrospective curve or threshold jump identifies future coverage or mechanism emergence; it does not.
concrete_scene.residual_owner: The forecast owner retains population, sampling, optimization, breakpoint, contamination, uncertainty, transfer, cost, and held-out scoring residuals.
concrete_scene.evidence_boundary: The finite review checks forecast custody and non-identifiability, not generalization, emergence, transfer, future scaling accuracy, or safety.

worked_trace.heading: Worked scaling forecast: two models enter, the holdout stays closed
worked_trace.maximum_inference: Prospective-design fields, attempt custody, and invalidation are coherent; broad generalization, transfer, emergence, scaling accuracy, and safety remain unproven.

counterexample_or_simpler_baseline: The curve-fitting baseline reports only the winning family after seeing the holdout. The governed forecast freezes both alternatives and preserves all attempts before results open.
readable_claim: A smooth curve through observed scales is a retrospective description until it predicts a frozen, genuinely held-out scale and survives plausible breakpoint alternatives.
normative_rule: Freeze the population, metric, compute regime, candidate families, fitting rule, uncertainty interval, breakpoint alternatives, and forecast horizon before opening held-out results. Keep failed runs and every preregistered alternative in the denominator; regime changes invalidate the receipt.

formal_binding.anchor: dated claim contract that binds population and sampling assumptions

caveat_consolidation.local_caveat: The worked forecast states once that custody cannot establish the predicted phenomenon.
caveat_consolidation.consolidated_disposition: Generalization, transfer, emergence, scaling, calibration, contamination, safety, support, and release remain distinct.

bookkeeping_surface_disposition: Attempt and model IDs remain because denominator custody is the example; the full 45-axis review stays in formal evidence.

editorial_diagnostics.mega_sentence_disposition: The short reader projection separates prospective prediction from the complete claim contract.
editorial_diagnostics.hedge_disposition: Limitations are consolidated around forecast custody rather than repeated as disclaimers.
editorial_diagnostics.table_disposition: Comparator tables remain because alternative scaling explanations are part of the argument.

non_claims: The worked forecast does not establish generalization or emergence.
A held-out forecast does not by itself establish transfer or safety.
The editorial revision does not move support or release state.
